tools.name: search_cards
tools.description: Search CARDZ public graded Pokémon or One Piece cards by name or collector number. Results contain candidate printings, languages, sets and canonical card links; multiple candidates may match a query. An empty result means no published match.

tools.name: get_card
tools.description: Read one exact CARDZ card ID. Results include PSA 10 reference price, population, market cap, changes, canonical URL, metric dates and daily history. Prices are daily observations in USD rather than executable live quotes; null values mean unavailable data.

tools.name: get_market
tools.description: Read CARDZ published market-cap rankings for Pokémon, One Piece or the combined index. Market cap is PSA 10 reference price multiplied by verified PSA 10 population. Results include the published order and effective date for the tracked index.
